run_compare_tokens_cli: run the compare_tokens CLI to compare tokens between two models
run_compare_tokens_verbose: run compare_tokens with verbose flag to print prompts from both models
run_compare_tokens_with_suffix: run compare_tokens with a type suffix like -embeddings for token comparison
run_compare_tokens_custom_data_dir: run compare_tokens specifying a custom data directory for token files
run_compare_tokens_shell_exit_code: run compare_tokens and check exit code for success or failure in shell scripts
